title: Record page: the default record page offers no way to turn on stage press, so authors must write a whole page
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第一组：会卡住人或误导人，立卡」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

Governing text: #28061 and PR #28303 made stage press an opt-in, `allowStageChange` on the `record:path` block, off by default. #11243 made the inert path stop looking like a control. This card does not reopen that default.

## What a customer sees

On a ticket the path shows New, In Progress, Resolved. A technician clicks In Progress and nothing happens. They open the edit form, face every field, and change Status there. Measured by clicking on the published 18.3.0.

## Measured

- An object that declares `stageField` gets its record page from `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, which draws `record:path` without `allowStageChange`.
- `allowStageChange` appears only on the block: `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:2175` and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`. No key on the object or the default page reaches it.
- So the author who wants this one behavior has to author and maintain a full record page. The stage press itself was not exercised in this walkthrough.

## Expected

An author can turn stage press on for the default record page without writing a page, in the same opt-in posture. Where the key belongs is for the contract review.
